items.html: And through this you will understand how the female is always included in the left; for most of her is from the left: in the right there is only Hochma in her, while in the left there are Gevura and Bina. And you must know that the Yesod of ZA also enters her in the secret of the brain of Daat; but it has in it only the aspect of the coronet of Gevura alone, for the aspect of Hesed within it is a small matter remaining in it, as above; and the main thing within it is this coronet of Gevura.
